s.note: Aunt Cass and her famous spicy wings
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp gochujang with 3 tbsp honey, crushed garlic and a splash of soy until glossy. Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds. Super spicy, like the cafe special.

Melt 200g white chocolate. Dip 20 marshmallows until fully coated and set on baking paper. Melt a little dark chocolate and pipe two small dots joined by a line on each one for the face. Leave to set. On a scale of one to ten, very cute.

m.note: the mash-up city of San Fransokyo
m.how: Braise 600g pork belly in soy and water for 2 hours, then slice. Whisk white miso into hot stock for the broth. Cook ramen noodles and soft-boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes. Build bowls with pork, halved eggs, nori and sliced spring onion.

w.note: the pastries at the Lucky Cat Café
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe small mounds and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and dry. Fold whipped cream into custard, fill each puff and dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L boiling water for 4 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp honey and the juice of a lemon. Serve hot in mugs, or cool it down and pour over ice with lemon slices. Good for healthcare companions and humans alike.
